input: myPlan optional ItemStack, pushDirection integer and upgrades
output: myPlan cache cleared; myPattern decoded or EMPTY; forcePlan reflects presence; direction restored only for nonempty pattern; plan recalculated
preservation: Derived plan rebuilt after actual saved item is restored. Missing plan resets force flag rather than keeping stale true.
application_limit: Direction.values indexed without bounds check. Borrow restore-source-before-derived-recompute, not treating load success as proof arbitrary IDs survived.

input: pattern inventory, priority, byte unlock reason, optional result stack, queued generic stacks, send direction, return inventory
output: restores actual patterns and return inventory; unknown unlock byte logs and yields null; result stack read only for RESULT; null queued stacks skipped
preservation: Clears unlockStack when reason not RESULT; defaults priority0 and sendDirection null. Pending sends rebuilt without executing a craft reward.
application_limit: Loop adds queued entries without explicit clear in this method; repeated load idempotence not established. Borrow separate persisted progress from derived/transient state.

input: energy plus dummy/process/running fields and compound sample
output: sample parsed only for compound tag; otherwise set EMPTY; process counters restored independently
preservation: Typed sample guard prevents interpreting scalar as item payload; energy delegated to already studied helper, no second credit for helper.
application_limit: parseOptional may lose invalid item; method does not preserve malformed payload. Borrow type-aware field selection, not blanket root copy.

input: enchantments optional encoded component, loot-table state or concrete items, sealingProgress
output: enchantments decoded or EMPTY; stored inventory loaded only if tryLoadLootTable false; sealingProgress read
preservation: Mutually exclusive pending-loot and resolved-inventory ownership prevents eagerly materializing both.
application_limit: fromNbtOrThrow may throw on corrupt present enchantments; absence fallback is distinct from invalid-data fallback. Preserve receipts separately from reward generation in Dynasty.

input: Fluid compound on machine item or absent Fluid key
output: stored fluid loaded or EMPTY; backing cache storage0 updated using stored.copy()
preservation: Explicit copy transfers payload ownership and synchronizes item-loaded state with runtime tank cache.
application_limit: contains lacks type argument, malformed compound not independently guarded. Borrow detached copies when transferring permanent NBT.

input: typed loot-table string/seed or saved item inventory
output: valid table ResourceKey restored and marked changed; invalid resource location clears table/seed; inventory deserialized only when no string loot key
preservation: Malformed present loot identifier does not run inventory fallback: this is an observed failure boundary, not called lossless.
application_limit: Borrow distinguishing missing target from invalid target and recording failure; do not silently convert missing legacy registry ID into EMPTY.

input: optional cell compound
output: ItemStack.of reconstructs saved cell or resets EMPTY if absent
preservation: Actual item holder reconstructed after super.load, avoids stale pre-load cell on missing key.
application_limit: contains not typed; ItemStack.of downstream invalid-ID behavior not guaranteed by this body. Separate real holder read from a mere getter.

input: typed stack compound, dealtDamage boolean, preferredSlot optional integer
output: restores projectile carried stack, damage state and slot default -1; derives loyalty and hit sound from reconstructed item
preservation: Item and associated return-slot metadata retained together; missing slot uses invalid sentinel instead of assuming slot0.
application_limit: No explicit reset for absent stack; superclass/current initialization matters. Borrow preserving progress metadata with correct type without copying temporary combat state.

input: fluid child, optional input/filter stacks and grind/pull cooldowns
output: restores both distinct item roles via OPTIONAL_CODEC or EMPTY; cooldowns default0
preservation: Role-specific payloads remain distinct; defaults spelled out using typed ValueInput API rather than explicit if/else.
application_limit: Inventory load is not a reason to copy player cooldowns across death. This place qualifies despite defaults supplied by typed API.

input: manager state, upgrades, lastRedstoneState integer
output: restores manager/upgrades; missing redstone state becomes UNDECIDED ordinal
preservation: Same-file getRedstoneState resolves UNDECIDED against world before use; saveAdditional writes upgrades and state.
application_limit: Ordinal out of bounds can throw. Borrow restore explicit durable upgrade data while recomputing unknown environment state; no credit for delegated manager body.

input: typed optional name, enchantments encoded tag and inventory; descPacket flag
output: name restored only if string; enchantments decode; concrete inventory loaded only for non-description packet
preservation: Client description update cannot overwrite full item inventory through this method; event/context ownership matters.
application_limit: Enchantment decode can throw; missing name leaves existing field unchanged. Analogously distinguish death clone from general sync, without requiring roundtrip in this method.

input: Compartments list plus superclass saved inventory; block wrapper optional UniqueId/CustomName
output: filters restored then normalized to exactly8 EMPTY entries if wrong size; superclass inventory restored; wrapper restores typed UUID/name
preservation: Filter validity controls insert acceptance; actual saved item inventory is delegated once, not discarded with invalid filter metadata. serializeNBT persists same compartment list.
application_limit: Invalid filter size loses all filters, not a lossless correction. Parent wrapper included as support with no extra credit. Borrow independent validation per owned subsystem.

input: Position float, Item compound and optional NetID
output: saved item and position produce package; supplied NetID preserved, absent NetID uses alternate constructor
preservation: Deep-read constructors: no-ID constructor allocates fresh atomic sequence ID, explicit-ID constructor stores item/pos/id and clears physics cache.
application_limit: Item parse failure can produce empty cargo. Borrow keep durable payload while rebuilding ephemeral runtime identity; network ID is not permanent player progression.

input: Inventory, ConnectedInput, GroupedItems, Phase string, CountDown, Cover
output: restores crafting payload; phase first IDLE then known enum name overrides; countdown/cover restored; animation branch only on client packet
preservation: Unknown phase has controlled IDLE fallback while item data already retained; server returns before purely visual transitions.
application_limit: Group decoder errors not studied here. Borrow treating unknown transient state separately from retained task counters; no rewards emitted by player clone.

input: optional Entity UUID, Speed float and Inventory compound
output: unoccupied controller records entityUUID/searchForEntity; speed and inventory restored
preservation: Entity reference recovered only when not already occupied, avoiding replacing current ownership; saved items reconstructed regardless of UUID branch.
application_limit: UUID conversion may throw; no blanket fallback promised. Borrow context-based ownership guards before permanent-field transfer.

trigger: Deployer.read before server fake player initialization
input: State/Mode/Timer/Powered, optional Owner UUID, Inventory ListTag, Overflow and HeldItem
output: retains deferred inventory list, owner, overflow and held stack; server skips visual Fistbump/Reach/Particle branch
preservation: Deep-read initialize: creates fakeplayer, loads deferred list into inventory, clears deferred reference, derives heldItem. write also retains deferred list when player not initialized.
application_limit: Not claiming ListTag copied: retained reference ownership differs from copy. Borrow preserve data until target consumer exists, never clear old progression merely because new player initialization is delayed.

input: Inventory compound, RecipeIndex integer and optional PlayEvent item
output: inventory and recipeIndex restored; optional event stack parsed
preservation: Restores work payload and continuation index before later processing; actual item deserialization is substantive despite no explicit missing-field branch.
application_limit: PlayEvent is animation state, not permanent progress. Borrow classify each co-located field; do not copy whole source NBT because inventory and animation share a reader.

input: HeldItem optional transported stack, OutputBuffer inventory, Incoming list plus canMergeItems capability
output: resets heldItem null before optional restore; loads output buffer; incoming only restored if merging allowed
preservation: Buffer and held cargo are separate ownership roles; incompatible incoming queue does not automatically apply to all depot modes.
application_limit: TransportedItemStack helper already studied, not additional credit here. Borrow explicit role/capability filters for permanent fields, not all root state.

input: address fields, HeldBox/InsertedBox stacks, QueuedExitingPackages, optional LastSummary; clientPacket
output: restores held/previous boxes and address; server decodes BigItemStack queue and summary; client returns before queue
preservation: Server-only durable queue not replaced by client visual packet; explicit Optional decode failure orElseThrow can abort load.
application_limit: Borrow isolate actual durable consumer from UI state and preserve Count/component payload by standard stack codec; no promise malformed queued packages recover.

input: InputItems/OutputItems, optional PreferredSpoutput, DisabledSpoutput strings, Overflow stacks and FluidOverflow
output: restores both inventories and overflow; preferred output reset null then optional direction; disabled set cleared/rebuilt; client-only visual queues afterward
preservation: Distinct persisted buffers restored independently before client-only effects; clears collections that are replaced rather than appending old+new.
application_limit: Direction.valueOf may throw on bad disabled name. Borrow idempotent replacement for owned state, not blind merge of all ForgeData.
